resources.string: Research assistant, phone control and AI model

Lets KGV X Intelligence read the screen and tap, type, swipe and take screenshots for you when you ask it to do something. It only acts while a task you started, or an MCP client you connected, is running.
Hi, I\'m KGV X Intelligence. Ask me to find and summarise articles on PubMed, build a literature review, or do something on your phone.
Ask or tell me to do something…
Listening… tap the mic to stop
Choose an AI model first: Settings › KGV X Intelligence.
Local (on this phone or your network)

Runs on your own hardware, so nothing you ask leaves it. Point it at an OpenAI-compatible server: llama.cpp (llama-server --jinja, port 8080), Ollama (port 11434/v1) or LM Studio on a PC (port 1234/v1). Qwen3.5 4B works well on a PC or laptop; use a model with tool calling.
Hundreds of hosted models with one key from openrouter.ai/keys. Pick one that supports tools; models with vision can read screenshots.
Any server with the OpenAI /chat/completions API (OpenAI, Groq, Together, vLLM…).
Only the local model controls the phone and sees your data; cloud models are locked out.
Send screenshots so a vision model can see the screen
Tap the mic in the assistant. Uses the phone\'s speech recognizer if one is installed, otherwise this Whisper-compatible endpoint (e.g. whisper.cpp server) and model.
Read the screen, tap, type, swipe and open apps
Let the model run commands as the Android system user
Double-tap the screen to turn it on
Hold Home for KGV X Intelligence (Default apps › Digital assistant)
Lets MCP clients (a local agent in Termux, Claude Desktop or an IDE) use all these skills. Over USB: adb forward tcp:8765 tcp:8765.
Clients on your Wi-Fi can connect with the token
